messages.content: "Can you help me with a couple of conversions? First, I have 5000 Euros that I want to convert into US Dollars using the latest exchange rate. Then, I have another 3000 Euros that I want to convert into British Pounds, but this time, I want to use the last known exchange rate. After that, I have a distance of 100 kilometers that I want to convert into miles. Lastly, I have a weight of 75 kilograms that I want to convert into pounds. Can you do these conversions for me?"

function.name: unit_conversion_convert
function.description: Converts a value from one unit to another. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: currency_exchange_convert
function.description: Converts a value from one currency to another using the latest exchange rate. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

amount.description: The amount of money to be converted.

live_conversion.description: If true, use the latest exchange rate for conversion, else use the last known rate. Default is true.

message.reasoning:
We need to perform conversions. We have two currency conversions: 5000 Euros to USD using live conversion. 3000 Euros to GBP using last known rate (live_conversion false). Then distance 100 km to miles. Weight 75 kg to pounds.

We have two functions: currency_exchange_convert and unit_conversion_convert. For distance and weight, we use unit_conversion_convert. For currency, use currency_exchange_convert.

We need to call functions twice for currency, and twice for unit conversion. We can chain calls or separate. We'll produce function calls.

We need to output the results. The user wants conversions. We should call functions accordingly.

We need to call currency_exchange_convert with amount=5000, from_currency="EUR", to_currency="USD", live_conversion=true. Then second call with amount=3000, from_currency="EUR", to_currency="GBP", live_conversion=false.

Then unit_conversion_convert for distance: value=100, from_unit="km", to_unit="mi". Then weight: value=75, from_unit="kg", to_unit="lb".

We need to output results. We'll call functions sequentially. Use the tool calls.
